#!/bin/sh
echo "Borg repo create"
/usr/bin/borgmatic repo-create --encryption repokey --append-only
echo "Borg backup create"
/usr/bin/borgmatic create
echo "Borg show info"
/usr/bin/borgmatic info --last 1
echo "Borg list archives"
/usr/bin/borgmatic list

acl url_discovery path /.well-known/caldav /.well-known/carddav
http-request redirect location /remote.php/dav/ code 301 if url_discovery
option http-keep-alive
timeout server 120000ms
